run_cal_train_time: run cal_train_time to analyze average training iteration time from JSON log files
run_plot_curve: run plot_curve to plot training metrics like mAP from JSON log files as curves
run_load_json_logs: run load_json_logs to parse JSON log files into epoch-keyed dictionaries of metrics
run_parse_args: run parse_args to build an argparse parser with plot_curve and cal_train_time subcommands
run_main: run main to analyze training logs by plotting curves or calculating train time via CLI
